marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Internet Sector
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed internet leaders rallied following earnings beats and policy announcements reinforcing support for digital platform growth and cloud infrastructure investment.
marketLayer.inference: Valuation multiples for major platform equities are positioned for baseline re-rating driven by disciplined cost structures and improving monetization in core business units.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustainability of domestic consumer demand recovery and potential geopolitical headwind exposures.

marketLayer.title: US AI & Semiconductor Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: US semiconductor heavyweights posted strong quarterly guidance citing unrelenting datacenter demand from cloud hyperscalers expanding AI capacity.
marketLayer.inference: Capital expenditure cycles across Big Tech remain firmly supportive of the hardware supply chain, cushioning broader market valuation levels.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Tight advanced packaging capacity constraints and upcoming macro data influencing Federal Reserve interest rate trajectory.

marketLayer.title: HK Biotech & Healthcare
marketLayer.fact: Several Hong Kong-listed innovative drug developers reported high-value out-licensing deals with global pharmaceutical majors.
marketLayer.inference: Cross-border commercialization capability is emerging as a critical catalyst for liquidity inflows into high-quality HK healthcare stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Regulatory price negotiation pressures in domestic markets and execution timing for late-stage clinical trials.
